problem: Exact canonical text fingerprints permit semantically duplicate surplus proposals when independent workers paraphrase the same problem, creating proposal spam and duplicate Planner work.
acceptance: The three 09:16-09:19 repository-host race pins are grouped into one semantic-equivalence cluster without deleting or rewriting any source pin or proposal.
Materially distinct owner, scope, privacy, output, problem, or acceptance semantics remain separate.
Cluster decisions are replayable and carry exact evidence refs plus a reason; uncertain matches remain unmerged rather than silently collapsed.
Planner or Steward can consume cluster heads and aliases so one semantic work item is generated while all source lineage remains preserved.
title: Semantic proposal dedup layer
mission: Implement a conservative append-only semantic-equivalence clustering layer after exact discovery fingerprint pinning. Preserve every source pin/proposal and lineage, but detect paraphrased proposals that describe the same substantive work, emit replayable alias clusters with evidence and uncertainty handling, and let Planner/Steward consume one cluster head instead of generating duplicate work.

regression_prevention.reason: Three distinct proposal fingerprints were durably pinned within minutes for the same repository-host proposal-pin race debt, demonstrating a real semantic false-negative in exact canonical dedup.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Without semantic clustering, Planner/Steward must manually reconcile paraphrased duplicate proposals produced by surplus workers.

unblock_value.reason: A conservative alias layer allows surplus discovery to scale beyond exact-string fingerprints while preserving append-only evidence and authority boundaries.

fail_if: the three observed host-race proposals remain three independent Planner work items
a clusterer deletes or rewrites any original pin/proposal
materially different owner/scope/privacy/output semantics are merged
uncertain semantic similarity is silently treated as identity
cluster output grants READY, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority
falsification.pass_if: The three observed paraphrased host-race pins are represented by one replayable semantic work cluster with all aliases and source lineage preserved, while adversarial materially-distinct proposals remain separate and uncertain matches fail closed.
